title: Armory: Progression
summary: Upgrade Armory in stable steps without skipping the safety layer.

blocks.title: Upgrade Path
blocks.body: Progress by matching gear to repeated problems: safer armor for damage spikes, utility modules for special routes, and backup tools when a fight interrupts salvage.

blocks.title: Do Not Skip The Middle
blocks.body: The middle step is usually boring because it is the safety layer: storage, markers, meters, counters, backups, or notes. Build that layer before raising the risk.

blocks.title: Ready For More
blocks.body: You are ready to push Armory further when the current loop feels repeatable, the failure signs are familiar, and the next upgrade has a clear purpose.

blocks.title: Upgrade Anchor
blocks.body: Use this as the upgrade checkpoint before raising route risk.
blocks.label: Iron Sword
blocks.subtitle: Progression checkpoint
